parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the cabinet, made of plywood. It provides the overall shape and support for the doors and shelves.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the cabinet doors, shelves, and top surface, maintaining the rigidity and stability of the furniture.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a solid wood panel attached to the front of the cabinet, designed to open and close for access to the storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior compartments of the cabinet and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates or swings on hinges attached to the frame, allowing it to open and close smoothly.
